1  critical  A departed person or retired account retains access (production)
   [identity.former_person_has_access]
   Subject       carol-gh (account carol-gh)
   You declared  engagement.yaml people.carol.left: Operator declaration at people.carol.left
   Observed      collaborators (12:00, as alice (user ID 41)): carol-gh; declared leaving date
                 passed
   Concluded from request:collaborators, declared:people.carol.left
   Severity      critical: base high, +1 attribute production write (collaborators: role_name:
                 write; admin: false; maintain: false; push: true; pull: true)
   Why here      This person left and can still push to example-org/production, which you declared
                 deploys to production, so this ranks one step higher.
   Fix           Complete offboarding: suspend or remove the account or its access, and review
                 credentials and sessions. If they could push to a repository that deploys to
                 production, also rotate the secrets that repository's workflows can read and its
                 deploy keys, and review its commits and workflow runs since their leaving date.
